stationterrace_fan.text: Welcome to my little museum. It is also my living room.
The Llangollen Railway is a heritage line. They run proper steam engines along the Dee, and the whistle gets me every time.
Steam trains use coal to heat water that makes steam that pushes pistons. Simple. Hard to get right.

then.text: Emrys Bowen. Joiner. I do doors, I do cabinets, I do a lovely coffin and I don't talk about the chair.
I do not know anything about any chair. I was in bed. Quite late. Humming? I never hum.
...Have a look at the bench if you like. It's only a bench.

else.text: Mind the sawdust, it gets everywhere.
